overview_description: Download the file stored in a custom attribute of the file type, as base64 text.
intro: An attribute attachment is the file a custom attribute of the file type holds for an account. This area has 1 endpoint, which returns that file as base64 text, and all seven SDKs call it.
notes: **The path is singular.** Call `/attribute_attachment/{file_uuid}`, not a plural form.
**The file comes back as a JSON object with one key, `base64`.** The body is `{"base64": "..."}`, so decode the `base64` value to get the file's bytes.
**Use the uuid the account's file attribute links to.** An account's file attribute points at this path; take the `file_uuid` from there.
**An unknown uuid returns `404`.** The error code is `resource_not_found`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an attribute attachment
endpoints.summary: Returns the file a custom file attribute holds, as base64 text.
endpoints.description: Reads the file that an account's file attribute links to. The body holds one key, `base64`, whose value is the file's content encoded as base64. Decode it to get the original bytes.

parameters.name: file_uuid
parameters.description: The file's `uuid`, the value an account's file attribute links to. A dashed uuid.

404.description: No file has that `uuid`. The error code is `resource_not_found`.
